title: Risk-Averse Welfare Maximization via Marginal Treatment Effects
abstract: arXiv:2609.30617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies risk-averse treatment allocation when individuals self-select into treatment based on unobserved characteristics. We develop a framework that combines the marginal treatment effect approach to endogenous selection with a general class of coherent risk measures that capture distributional preferences over welfare outcomes. We show that the planner's problem admits equivalent interpretations in terms of uncertainty aversion, distributional robustness, and worst-case welfare. For law-invariant coherent risk measures, we derive a Kusuoka representation that expresses the planner's objective as a weighted evaluation of different regions of the welfare distribution and characterize the resulting optimal allocation rule. We further establish finite-sample regret guarantees for empirical risk-averse policy learning, showing how the statistical difficulty of learning a policy depends on the planner's sensitivity to adverse welf

translated_title: 基于边际处理效应的风险规避福利最大化
translated_abstract: 本文研究了当个体基于不可观测特征自选择进入处理时，如何进行风险规避的处理分配问题。我们开发了一个框架，将处理内生选择的边际处理效应方法与一类广泛的相干风险度量相结合，以刻画对福利结果的分布性偏好。我们证明，规划者的问题可以在不确定性厌恶、分布鲁棒性以及最坏情况福利等方面获得等价的解释。对于分布不变的相干风险度量，我们推导出了Kusuoka表示，将规划者的目标表述为对福利分布不同区域的加权评估，并刻画了由此产生的最优分配规则。我们进一步为经验性风险规避政策学习建立了有限样本遗憾保证，说明了学习一项政策的统计难度如何取决于规划者对不利福利结果的敏感程度。
tldr: 本文提出了一个将边际处理效应方法与相干风险度量相结合的新框架，用于解决个体自选择情形下的风险规避福利最大化分配问题，并给出了规划者目标的Kusuoka表示、最优分配规则的刻画以及政策学习的有限样本遗憾保证。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a framework combining marginal treatment effects with coherent risk measures for risk-averse treatment allocation under self-selection, providing a Kusuoka representation of the planner's objective, characterizing the optimal allocation rule, and establishing finite-sample regret guarantees for policy learning.
